title: UAP-class objects coming down from the outer atmosphere south of Picatinny
summary: Jake Barber tells of UAP-class objects coming down from the outer atmosphere south of Picatinny, about December 2024 at Airspace south of Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Airspace south of Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey

tellings.quote: And we had UAP class stuff popping up to the south of there, coming in from the outer atmosphere and hovering into place and going back into space.
